bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
case "$(git remote get-url origin)" in *seigo-gace/create-videobot*) ;; *) exit 61;; esac
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
stage="$root/.worktrees/video-stars-361267cb"
sha="361267cb5e636d4fcc70655c63dada5672a98916"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 62
test -z "$(git -C "$stage" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" || exit 63
mapfile -t ids < <(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll)
test "${#ids[@]}" -eq 1 || exit 64
id="${ids[0]}"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Config.Image}}' "$id")" = "create-videobot:video-ui-be4f34d" || { echo VIDEO_RUNTIME_IMAGE_CHANGED; exit 65; }
project="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$id")"
files="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}' "$id")"
base="${files%%,*}"
case "$base" in *compose.videobot.poll.yaml) ;; *) exit 66;; esac
test -f "$base" || exit 67
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$base" config --quiet || exit 68
docker image inspect create-videobot:video-ui-be4f34d >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 69
echo VIDEO_BASE_COMPOSE=PASS
echo VIDEO_STICKER_STARS_SOURCE=PASS
echo VIDEO_RUNTIME_IMAGE=VERIFIED
